subject: Change text color in a Chunk

messages.author: e1c0d70b0dc3a0f6
messages.subject: Change text color in a Chunk
parts: It appears that the default text color when knitting from RNW to PDF is some sort of gray.  I would like to make the text a darker gray or black.  I cannot seem to find an option for this (i.e., similar to setting the chunk background color) or a description of a hook for doing this (though there seems to be a "text" hook).  This seems like it should be easy.  Can someone point in my the right direction?  Thank you in advance for your help.
